capabilities: Register vault word-list entries with the OS spellchecker
Add or remove words via a right-click context menu
Watch the dictionary file and re-sync on save
Remove all plugin-managed words with a command
extras: Desktop only (macOS, Windows, Linux); no mobile support. Registered words go into the OS-wide per-user dictionary, so they are visible to other apps and persist across restarts. Disabling the plugin leaves words registered; a command clears them.
intentEvidence: reads a markdown word list from your vault and injects it into Obsidian's spellchecker
problem: Obsidian's spellchecker flags proper nouns and invented words as errors, and words added natively don't travel with the vault when it is moved or shared.
summary: Dictionary syncer that registers words from a markdown word list in your vault into Obsidian's spellchecker so proper nouns stop being flagged.
